# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for

consumers to live well.

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us

We combine pioneering solutions and proprietary market insights with formulation
expertise—delivering the cleaner ingredients and simpler labels that consumers understand and
prefer.

We bring our extensive portfolio of sustainable plant-protein solutions and formulation expertise to
help customers bring products with consumer-preferred taste, texture and nutrition to market.

[Learn more][8]

flavors while solving better-for-you product challenges.

[Learn more][9]

We combine our 100+ years of texturant know-how with our passion for food science and broadest
portfolio of texturizing solutions to help manufacturers achieve their formulation needs.

[Learn more][10]

# Strategic sourcing

We are the strategic supply chain partner and ingredient logistics expert for industry leading
producers in the Northeastern and Mid Atlantic United States.

Our short rail ownership allows access to national railways, where we bring in the world’s best
ingredients. Through our 13 rail spurs, with over 75M pounds of inventory capacity, our facilities
can process, package and redistribute your ingredients. Strategically located to serve the
Northeastern and Mid Atlantic markets—with proximity to major interstates—we leverage in transit
heat, covered transfers and other solutions to solve bulk liquid logistics and distribution
challenges.

### All about the WHEN

Fulfillment timing is essential to keeping your business running with quality ingredients.
Ingredients PLUS’s agile operations enables fulfillment in hours, not days or weeks.

[Magnifying Glass over a Box Icon]

### Streamlined sourcing

Our strategic sourcing partnerships, expertise in supply chain planning and buying, company owned
rail and transportation fleet, and advanced processing and logistics means you can count of us to
deliver quality ingredients, When and Where you need them.

[Information Icon]

### Technology backed

Our advanced logistics technology, geospatial analytics, and data driven solutions ensure your
ingredients arrive on time, while reducing emissions and waste through efficient route planning.

# Our mission is to provide outstanding customer care each day, every day

For more than 40 years, we've brought passion and innovation to the ingredients industry. Because we
know what on-time delivery and quality products mean: smiles on your customers' faces.
We design efficient, technology driven supply chain solutions so that you can achieve your demand
schedules – On Time and In Full delivery is our promise.
[
Contact us to learn more
][67]

# Strategic sourcing

We are the strategic supply chain partner and ingredient logistics expert for industry leading
producers in the Northeastern and Mid Atlantic United States.

Our short rail ownership allows access to national railways, where we bring in the world’s best
ingredients. Through our 13 rail spurs, with over 75M pounds of inventory capacity, our facilities
can process, package and redistribute your ingredients. Strategically located to serve the
Northeastern and Mid Atlantic markets—with proximity to major interstates—we leverage in transit
heat, covered transfers and other solutions to solve bulk liquid logistics and distribution
challenges.

### Ingredients

# Aspartame

[Home][22] » [Ingredients][23] » [Sweeteners][24] » Aspartame

## Low-Calorie Sweetener and Flavor Enhancer

Aspartame is a low-calorie sweetener, which is approximately 200 times sweeter than sugar and one of
the most extensively studied ingredients in the food supply.  By providing sweetness without added
calories, aspartame helps reduce or replace added sugars while maintaining taste, serving as both a
sweetener and flavor enhancer.

Aspartame is composed of two amino acids, phenylalanine and aspartic acid and methanol. Its chemical
name is L-aspartyl-L-phenylalanine methyl ester. Amino acids, often referred to as the building
blocks for proteins, link together to form proteins.

Aspartame is found in thousands of products worldwide, including carbonated and powdered soft
drinks, chewing gum, confections, gelatins, dessert mixes, puddings and fillings, frozen desserts,
yogurt, tabletop sweeteners, and select pharmaceuticals such as vitamins and sugar-free cough drops.

## Benefits of Aspartame

Tastes Like Sugar

Studies conducted with taste-test panels show that many believe aspartame’s taste is very similar to
the taste of sugar. Because it is 200 times sweeter than table sugar, substantially less aspartame
is needed to sweeten foods and beverages.

Helpful in Diabetes Management

Aspartame offers people living with diabetes greater variety and flexibility in budgeting their
total carbohydrate intake and allows them to satisfy their taste for sweets without affecting blood
sugar.

Enhances and Extends Flavors

Aspartame has the ability to intensify and extend fruit flavors, such as cherry and ‎orange, in foods
and beverages. For example, aspartame makes chewing gum taste ‎sweet and more flavorful longer than
sugar-sweetened gum.‎

Helps Prevent Tooth Decay

According to the American Dental Association, low-calorie sweeteners like aspartame do not promote
decay-causing acids that can harm teeth. Clinical studies have shown that chewing sugarless gum for
20 minutes following meals can help prevent tooth decay.

Can be Beneficial for Weight Management

Consuming products with aspartame can result in lower caloric intake, which helps people ‎manage
their weight, which has been confirmed by several studies.‎

## Facts About Aspartame

### Origin

Aspartame was discovered in 1965 by James M. Schlatter. Schlatter obtained this compound as part of
his research and discovered the sweetness completely by accident, after licking it off his finger.
Its large-scale production began in 1981 after it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug
Administration (FDA). As aspartame is about 200 times sweeter than sugar, it is attractive for use
as a sweetener, particularly as it provides basically zero calories at intended use levels.

### Safety

Aspartame is one of the most thoroughly studied ingredients in the food supply. It has been reviewed
in more than 100 scientific studies before the FDA approved it in 1981. The studies were conducted
in laboratory animals and humans, including healthy infants, children, and adults, lactating women,
people with diabetes, and obese individuals.  Upon approving aspartame, the FDA Commissioner noted,
“Few compounds have withstood such detailed testing and repeated, close scrutiny, and the process
through which aspartame has gone should provide the public with additional confidence of its
safety.”

After the [FDA’s approval][25], extensive additional research has been done with aspartame, which
further confirmed its safety for the general population. In fact, aspartame has been tested for more
than three decades, in more than 200 studies, with the same result: aspartame is safe.

The FDA has established an [Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI)][26] of 50 mg/kg of body ‎weight. An ADI
represents the daily intake limit whereby a substance can be ‎consumed each day with no safety
concern.

Further, as it is rapidly degraded in the gastrointestinal tract, and that even when consumed at
levels equivalent to the ADI (or based on exposure data reported in some countries), the resulting
exposure to its breakdown components (two amino acids and methanol) remains far lower than that from
dietary protein and natural fruits

In 2023, the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) reviewed aspartame and citing
“limited evidence” for carcinogenicity in humans, classified it as possibly carcinogenic to humans
(Group 2B). IARC’s conclusions were examined by the Joint Food and Agriculture Organization
(FAO)/World Health Organization (WHO) Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA) in its 2023
evaluation of asp

Scientific Affairs, the American Diabetes Association, and the American Dietetic Association, now
known as the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, have reviewed research on aspartame and found it to

decay-causing acids that can harm teeth. Clinical studies have shown that chewing sugarless gum for
20 minutes following meals can help prevent tooth decay.

Can be Beneficial for Weight Management

Consuming products with aspartame can result in lower caloric intake, which helps people ‎manage
their weight, which has been confirmed by several studies.‎

## Facts About Aspartame

### Origin

Aspartame was discovered in 1965 by James M. Schlatter. Schlatter obtained this compound as part of
his research and discovered the sweetness completely by accident, after licking it off his finger.
Its large-scale production began in 1981 after it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug
Administration (FDA). As aspartame is about 200 times sweeter than sugar, it is attractive for use
as a sweetener, particularly as it provides basically zero calories at intended use levels.

### Safety

Aspartame is one of the most thoroughly studied ingredients in the food supply. It has been reviewed
in more than 100 scientific studies before the FDA approved it in 1981. The studies were conducted
in laboratory animals and humans, including healthy infants, children, and adults, lactating women,
people with diabetes, and obese individuals.  Upon approving aspartame, the FDA Commissioner noted,
“Few compounds have withstood such detailed testing and repeated, close scrutiny, and the process
through which aspartame has gone should provide the public with additional confidence of its
safety.”

After the [FDA’s approval][25], extensive additional research has been done with aspartame, which
further confirmed its safety for the general population. In fact, aspartame has been tested for more
than three decades, in more than 200 studies, with the same result: aspartame is safe.

The FDA has established an [Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI)][26] of 50 mg/kg of body ‎weight. An ADI
represents the daily intake limit whereby a substance can be ‎consumed each day with no safety
concern.

Further, as it is rapidly degraded in the gastrointestinal tract, and that even when consumed at
levels equivalent to the ADI (or based on exposure data reported in some countries), the resulting
exposure to its breakdown components (two amino acids and methanol) remains far lower than that from
dietary protein and natural fruits

In 2023, the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) reviewed aspartame and citing
“limited evidence” for carcinogenicity in humans, classified it as possibly carcinogenic to humans
(Group 2B). IARC’s conclusions were examined by the Joint Food and Agriculture Organization
(FAO)/World Health Organization (WHO) Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA) in its 2023
evaluation of aspartame. [JECFA found no concern for human health][27]. The [FDA also disagreed with
IARC’s conclusion][28] that these studies support classifying aspartame as a possible carcinogen to
humans. Importantly, IARC is not a food safety body and its 2B classification does not consider
intake levels nor actual risk, making an IARC review far less comprehensive than the thorough
reviews conducted by food safety organizations like JECFA, leading to potential confusion for
consumers.

### Regulatory Status

In addition to FDA and JECFA, aspartame has been reviewed and determined to be safe by the
Scientific Committee on Food of the European Commission and the regulatory bodies of over 100
countries. Independent health organizations, such as the American Medical Association’s Council on
Scientific Affairs, the American Diabetes Association, and the American Dietetic Association, now
known as the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, have reviewed research on aspartame and found it to
be safe.

# Home

[instant noodles]

## [Multi-country outbreak of *Salmonella* Stanley infections linked to flavoured noodle
## products][199]

Over 100 cases have been reported across Europe, mainly affecting children and young adults, with
evidence linking the outbreak to flavoured noodle products.

[field with vehicle]

## [EFSA lowers safe level for exposure to TFA ][200]

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has reduced the safe level of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA)
in the diet based on new scientific evidence. TFA is a breakdown product of some pesticides.

[xylella conference]

## [5th European Conference on Xylella fastidiosa: science drives progress towards sustainable
## management][201]

The 5^{th} European Conference on *Xylella fastidiosa* concluded today in Mola di Bari,
Italy, confirming that research on one of the world's most damaging plant pathogens has reached a
new level of maturity.

[alfalfa sprouts]

## [Multi-country Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouted seeds ][202]

Alfalfa sprouted seeds have been identified as the likely source of a multi-country outbreak of
*Salmonella* Bovismorbificans infections, according to a Rapid Outbreak Assessment (ROA) published
by EFSA and ECDC.

## Our other platforms

### [OpenEFSA][209]

All you need to know about our risk assessments

Dedicated portal hosting comprehensive information on our risk assessments, from receipt of a
mandate or dossier to adoption of an output. Go here to check the status of assessments, and to
browse data and studies, meeting agendas and minutes, and details about experts.

### [EFSA Journal][210]

Our open-access scientific journal

EFSA’s online journal, hosting all our published scientific outputs and supporting documents.

### [Connect][211]

Bringing together EFSA and its stakeholders

Need to ask us about pre-submission advice, public consultations, public access to documents,
notification of studies or other similar issues? The Connect platform is where you will find the
answers.

widely used ingredient in the chemical industry, known for its ability to retain moisture and
maintain hydration in various formulations. Produced from both plant and animal sources, glycerine

pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors. Glycerine Manufacturers focus on producing high-quality, pure

manufacturers involved in custom chemical manufacturing, where consistent performance and purity are

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

][73]
[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

condition

to 5 feet 7 inches around the world

From hydration to meditation, little changes can yield big benefits

## [Tirzepatide vs. Semaglutide][21]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/tirzepatide-vs-semaglutide

Both are GLP-1 medications that are FDA-approved for Type 2 diabetes and weight loss, but how they
work differs

## [When To Seek Care for Diarrhea (and Where To Go)][23]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/when-to-see-a-doctor-for-diarrhea

Get help if it lasts more than a couple days or comes with other worrying symptoms

[Primary Care][24]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/universal-blood-donor-type

People of any blood type can receive type O negative red blood cells (but not plasma and platelets)

## Summer Sneezes and Sniffles

[[Person coughing into arm under the influence of the sun]][26]
[Allergies][27]

##### [ACHOO Syndrome: Why You Sneeze When You Look at the Sun][28]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/why-does-the-sun-cause-me-to-sneeze

The photic sneeze reflex is a surprisingly common reaction to bright lights

[[Hand adjusting the temperature on AC unit]][29]
[Wellness][30]

##### [Is Your AC Making You Sick?][31]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-air-conditioning-make-you-sick

If you feel sick, it’s probably because of air quality — not your air conditioner

[[Person coughing into a tissue by window during sunny, summer day]][32]
[Cold, Flu & Respiratory Illnesses][33]

##### [Summer Sniffles: Winter Isn’t the Only Time You Can Catch a Cold][34]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/summer-cold

Enteroviruses are often to blame for summer colds, leading to a runny nose, sore throat and
digestive symptoms

[[Field of white fluffy dandelions, with pollen floating in the breeze]][35]
[Allergies][36]

##### [What Triggers Summer Allergies and How To Find Relief][37]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/summer-allergies

Keeping your windows closed, showering before bed and using OTC allergy meds may help keep summer
sniffles at bay

## In It for the Long Run

[[Person using fartlek techique while running in a park]][38]
[Exercise & Fitness][39]

##### [What Is Fartlek Training?][40]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/fartlek-run

This flexible ‘speed play’ running workout mixes fast and slow paces to build endurance, boost
fitness and keep your routine from getting ... too routine

[[Person looking over a new running shoe in a store]][41]
[Exercise & Fitness][42]

##### [How To Pick the Right Running Shoes][43]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-to-pick-the-running-shoe-that-is-best-for-you

[[Person walking dog and person running in a park, with person sitting on a bench]][44]

Improve your speed with interval training, strength training and consistent, healthy habits

[Women’s Health][57]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/what-is-the-average-height-for-women

In the U.S., the average height for women is 5 feet 3.5 inches, and it ranges from 4 feet 11 inches
to 5 feet 7 inches around the world

[[Woman doing a yoga stretch in their living room]][59]
[Exercise & Fitness][60]

##### [Does Stretching Make You Taller?][61]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/does-stretching-make-you-taller

Stretching won't increase your height, but it can help you stand taller

[[Healthcare provider measuring male's height in medical office]][62]
[Men’s Health][63]

##### [The Average Height for Men, and What It Means for Men’s Health][64]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/what-is-the-average-height-for-a-man

Globally, the average height for men ranges from 5 feet 3 inches to 6 feet 0.4 inches, but varies
based on a variety of factors

[[Older people dancing together]][65]
[Rheumatology & Immunology][66]

##### [Do You Really Shrink With Age?][67]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-avoid-losing-height-get-older

Losing a little height is normal, but bigger changes can signal bone weakening and osteoporosis

## Understanding Your Thryoid

[[Healthcare provider using oversized magnifying glass on oversized person's neck, checking their
thyroid]][68]
[Diabetes & Endocrinology][69]

##### [What’s the Difference Between Hypothyroidism and Hyperthyroidism?][70]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/whats-the-difference-between-hypothyroidism-and-hyperthyroidism

Hypothyroidism is underactivity of your thyroid gland, while hyperthyroidism is overactivity — but
both conditions need treatment

[[Assorted fruits, nuts and seeds in bowls and on table]][71]
[Diabetes & Endocrinology][72]

##### [Thyroid Issue? Here’s What To Eat and What To Avoid][73]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/thyroid-issues-what-you-need-to-know-about-diet-and-supplements

No diet can cure hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism, but some foods and supplements can cause trouble

[[close up of female pulling hairs from a brush]][74]
[Diabetes & Endocrinology][75]

##### [Is My Thyroid to Blame for My Hair Loss?][76]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/is-my-thyroid-condition-to-blame-for-my-hair-loss

The endocrine gland in charge of hormone production may be causing your hair to shed or stop growing

[[A plate of baked cod and vegetables]][77]
[Diabetes & Endocrinology][78]

##### [A Healthy Hypothyroidism Diet: What To Eat, Avoid and Why][79]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/hypothyroidism-diet

thyroid function

# We work to create sustainable
# food & agriculture systems.

[About Us][27]
[Newsletter Signup][28]

## Our Latest

Discover IATP’s most recent articles, reports and projects.

[[cows overlaid with EU flag]][29]

Jul 2, 2026

Jun 23, 2026
[All articles & reports][35]
[Agroecology Uprooted]

## Agroecology Uprooted

With food systems and the planet in crisis, what would true resilient, sustainable, and just
solutions look like? The answer may lie in a method called [agroecology][36], a holistic approach to
food, agriculture, nature, and social systems that’s already taking root around the globe.

All five episodes of our latest podcast miniseries are now available to stream.

[Listen now][37]

## We approach our work from a systems perspective.

IATP understands the interconnection between agriculture, trade and climate.

[an illustration of two links, linked together.]
We analyze issue interdependence.

We see how interrelationships between issues within complex societal structures make it challenging
to effect change but also open powerful opportunities.

[An illustration of connected dots. ]
We unpack power dynamics.

We ask who has the power? Who wins and loses? Who is at the table when decisions are made?

[An illustration of a network]
We identify key levers of change.

We identify opportunities for big changes within trade, agriculture and climate policy. And we
propose bold solutions that will bring us closer to our vision.

[What is systems thinking? ][38]
[American flags in front of U.S. capitol]

## Eyes on the Trump Administration

As we navigate the changing political landscape, IATP remains committed to our principles, including
evidence, public accountability and human dignity. We have created a hub for our work tracking the
administration’s actions and analyzing their impacts.

[Read the latest][39]
[Tariffs 101][40]

## Blood Orange Sugar-Free Sweet Tea

Indulge in the vibrant allure of a sugar-free blood orange sweet tea. With the tangy essence of
freshly squeezed blood orange and earthy undertones of premium tea leaves, each sip is a

Read More

burst of sunshine balanced perfectly with the well-rounded sweetness of erythritol, stevia, and monk
fruit. It’s a guilt-free, tantalizing treat that will have you savoring every drop while knowing
you’re making a health conscious choice.

#### Feature Ingredients

LegacyTMSWEET SP 9708-50 at 8.90%. Benefit of a Sugar Replacer.

Keto Friendly | Sugar Replacer | Natural Flavor | Vegan | Label Friendly |

Water, Erythritol, Tea Concentrate, Natural Flavor, Citric Acid, Monk Fruit Extract, Steviol
Glycoside (Rebaudioside M)

This deliciously sweet, refreshing, sugar-free, & guilt-free beverage transports your taste buds
straight to summer. Cool off and relax while sipping on IFPC’s custom pineapple

Read More

dream drink.

Legacy™SWEET SR 9706 at 1:1 ratio for it’s ketogenic benefits and as a sugar replacer

Color

This blueberry green tea from Brownsboro is a refreshing beverage with less than 1g of added sugars!
Sip and enjoy this perfectly balanced sweet summer drink with sweetness

Read More

supplemented by IFPC’s custom designed Legacy™SWEET systems.

#### Feature Ingredients

Legacy™SWEET Sugar Replacement Systems. Complete assortment of sweetener systems, sugar replacers
and reducers that are adaptable to virtually all products.

#### Ingredient Statement

*Brewed Organic Green Tea (Water + Tea), Proprietary Sweetener Blend (Erythritol, Stevia),
Brownsboro Blueberries (Blueberries, Cane Sugar), Natural Blueberry Flavoring, Honey, Malic Acid.
Gluten Free | Sugar Reducer | Natural Flavor | Vegan | Label Friendly |

Start your day with a healthy and tasty treat. The mango plant-based drinkable yogurt will keep your
guy happy and healthy. Just one glass of this beverage is packed with prebiotic

Read More

properties while also serving a good source of fiber and protein!

#### Feature Ingredients

LegacyTEX® Botana 7812-50 at 0.1% for viscosity, emulsification, and shelf-life

Fava Bean Protein Concentrate at 2.8% for a good source of protein

Inulin at 0.5% for prebiotic fiber

#### Ingredient Statement

Water, Coconut Milk, Sugar, Mango Puree, Fava Bean Protein Concentrate, Inulin, Natural Flavor, Guar

Natural Flavor | Vegan

beach vacation.

Water, Erythritol, Malic Acid, Natural Flavor, Citric Acid, Monk Fruit Extract, Vegetable Juice

A refreshingly smooth coffee combined with milk and served over ice for a subtly sweet and delicious

Dairy House® Stabilizer System at 0.3% for stabilization.

## WELCOME TO ANHUI KEMFOOD INTERNATIONAL

###### Kemfood International is an up-rising company dedicated to the research & development and
###### mass production of food/pharm/feed preservatives.
* [learn more][34]
* [products][35]

## WIDE RANGE OF APPLICATIONS
* Beverages
* Dairy products
* Baking
* Cookies
* Jelly
* Candy
* Sausage
* ##### Beverages
  
  A wide range of ingredients are required in their formulation of beverages.Additives like sugar or
  sweeteners which are added in higher amounts whereas additives like preservatives are added in
  small quantity. Hence additives may be grouped as Major and Minor additives.
* ##### Dairy products
  
  Dairy system is a complex colloidal dispersion system, the dispersion medium is water, and the
  dispersions are lactose, inorganic salts, protein, fat, gas, etc. It is an unstable system. Dairy
  products are both highly nutritious and highly unstable substances that are prone to spoilage.
  emulsifier in dairy milk and preservatives used in milk are important for dairy processing.
  Nutritional fortification, stabilization of the milk system, and extension of shelf life. When
  adding natural vegetable fiber ingredients and transglutaminase for sale to milk with wheat,
  cereals, eggs and other substances, add emulsification stabilizers to delay the floating of milk
  fat and protein precipitation to achieve a balance of emulsion, so that the product does not
  stratify and change the structure, and extend the shelf life.
* ##### Baking
  
  Food attives is widely used in baking.They were added to flour products for a variety of purposes,
  including bleaching the flour, ageing, slowing the rate of staling, and improving the texture of
  the finished product,Kemfood shall provide the best sulotion for you.
* ##### Cookies
  
  The ingredients used in preparation of cookies affect size, color, and sensory qualities.
  Additional ingredients are also added for flavor and texture. There are two main types of cookies,
  soft and hard cookies. Soft cookies contain more liquids to produce the necessary structure i.e.,
  moistness and softness. THE MAIN INGREDIENTS present in nearly every type of cookie are wheat
  flour, sweeteners ,fat,sodium bicarbonate and ammonium bicarbonate.
* ##### Jelly
  
  The application of food ingredients especially food thickeners is a key technology in jelly
  production. Substances essential for fruit jelly making are fruit flavor, pectin, sugar, acid and
  water. A pectin gel or jelly forms when a suitable concentration of pectin, sugar, acid, and water
  is achieved.
* ##### Candy
  
  Food additives are substances added to food to preserve flavour or enhance its taste and
  appearance. There are many types of food additives in candy which serve different purposes such as
  emulsifiers, stabilizers, thickeners, anti­caking agents, preservatives, antioxidants, leavening
  agents, acidulants, and natural or artificial colours and flavours.
  A main component of candies is food colouring. There are two types of food colourings – natural
  and artificial. Natural food colourings are obtained from natural sources such as extracts from
  plants like flowers and roots. For example, orange food colouring can be derived from saffron
  tendrils. Natural food colouring can also be obtained from an insect (Cochineal) by crushing them
  to release carminic acid which has a red colour.
* ##### Sausage
  
  The addition of additives in the production of sausages improves preservation and modifies the
  sensory characteristics of the sausage. Most Additives used in sausage & jerky making are not
  spices and do not do necessarily "Season The Meat". They usually perform a function such as
  retaining color or moisture. They can also protect meat from bacteria while smoking or drying.
  However, some additives such as cures do affect taste and color to a degree. Always follow the
  directions provided and do not add more than directed.

  dispersions are lactose, inorganic salts, protein, fat, gas, etc. It is an unstable system. Dairy
  products are both highly nutritious and highly unstable substances that are prone to spoilage.

  adding natural vegetable fiber ingredients and transglutaminase for sale to milk with wheat,
  cereals, eggs and other substances, add emulsification stabilizers to delay the floating of milk
  fat and protein precipitation to achieve a balance of emulsion, so that the product does not
  stratify and change the structure, and extend the shelf life.
* ##### Baking

  including bleaching the flour, ageing, slowing the rate of staling, and improving the texture of

  moistness and softness. THE MAIN INGREDIENTS present in nearly every type of cookie are wheat
  flour, sweeteners ,fat,sodium bicarbonate and ammonium bicarbonate.

  production. Substances essential for fruit jelly making are fruit flavor, pectin, sugar, acid and
  water. A pectin gel or jelly forms when a suitable concentration of pectin, sugar, acid, and water
  is achieved.

  appearance. There are many types of food additives in candy which serve different purposes such as
  emulsifiers, stabilizers, thickeners, anti­caking agents, preservatives, antioxidants, leavening
  agents, acidulants, and natural or artificial colours and flavours.

  and artificial. Natural food colourings are obtained from natural sources such as extracts from
  plants like flowers and roots. For example, orange food colouring can be derived from saffron
  tendrils. Natural food colouring can also be obtained from an insect (Cochineal) by crushing them
  to release carminic acid which has a red colour.

Medicinal Plants

### [The Joint Pain Remedy Big Pharma Couldn't Patent - It Still Grows Free in Your Yard][24]

Solomon's seal (Polygonatum) is the arching shade-garden plant whose Greek name means "many knees" -
named after the joints it treated. Dioscorides recorded it in the 1st century; Gerard 1597 called it
unmatched for broken bones; Chinese pharmacies still sell it as Yu Zhu. A 2023 Phytochemistry review
catalogued 150+ steroidal saponins with anti-inflammatory and anti-osteoporotic activity; the root
contains diosgenin - the sapogenin pharma has used to build steroid drugs. Crowned 2013 Perennial
Plant of the Year as scenery.

[Watch & Read →][25]
[Episode 159 Chicory Thumbnail]
Medicinal Plants

### [It Tastes Like Coffee. It's Pure Fiber. Grows Free in the Ditch. Why Did the Government Call It
### a Crime?][26]

Chicory (Cichorium intybus) is the pale-blue-flowered roadside plant whose roasted taproot
Napoleon's 1806 Continental System turned into cafe chicoree, that Cafe du Monde has poured since
1862, that Harvey Wiley's 1892 Bureau of Chemistry and the 1906 Pure Food and Drug Act criminalized
as coffee fraud, and that Gibson and Roberfroid's 1995 paper made the founding case study for the
word "prebiotic." The FDA formally recognized chicory root fiber as dietary fiber in 2018.

[Watch & Read →][27]
[Episode 150 Staghorn Sumac Thumbnail]
Medicinal Plants

### [Tastes Like Lemonade. Loaded With Vitamin C. People Destroy It Thinking It's Poison. Why?][28]

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

Through our capabilities in owned factories, local sourcing, factory audits, warehousing, and
after-sales support, we ensure a stable and fully controlled supply chain for our customers.

  Core Supplier of Citric Acid, Citrates, Sweeteners, and Phosphates
  23+ Years of Experience
  Exporting to 100+ Countries Worldwide
  With Necessary Certifications
  China, Korea, Netherlands, Hong Kong & UK Offices; Thailand Factory

## About Niran Bio Tech

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global supplier network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of acidulants and functional ingredients, supporting
consistent quality, flavor balance, and performance across diverse food and beverage applications,
including beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy, and nutrition products.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

  * [Our Team][88]
    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
    customers.
    
    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support
    to deliver what we promise when we promise.
  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.
  * [Compliance][92]
    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.
    
    Implementation of the required control systems enable us to meet all regulatory compliance and
    legislation, ensuring the chemicals and services we provide to you achieve consistent standards
    and exceed your expectations.

# Industrial chemical supplies and services for the UK and Ireland

### DISCOVER PLATER

[plater mini logo]

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and
contract packaging. This integrated approach allows us to deliver consistent, compliant and
cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage
